build_ResUNet: build a ResUNet encoder-decoder with residual blocks and transposed conv upsampling for spatial prediction
build_ImpalaEncoder: build an IMPALA encoder with configurable ResNet stacks and MLP head for state representation learning
build_ResNet5: build a lightweight ResNet5 with residual blocks supporting 4D and 5D tensor inputs via TemporalBatchMixin
build_RNNPredictor: build a GRU-based RNNPredictor for single-step state propagation given actions and hidden states
build_InverseDynamicsModel: build an InverseDynamicsModel MLP that predicts actions from consecutive state pairs for auxiliary learning
